headline: Feels like Claude Code: bookmarks, history and logos
pill: a Claude Code-style header with bookmarks and history
summary: The chat header now works like Claude Code's: bookmark a conversation, open your history from the clock, start a new chat from the bubble. Replies carry each agent's own logo when the Claude Code and Codex extensions are installed.

highlights.title: Bookmarks and history, one click away
highlights.text: Bookmark the conversation you're in from the header. The clock opens your history, searchable, with bookmarked conversations at the top and each one's age, rounds and outcome; it also offers **Continue from a Claude Code or Codex session…**. The speech bubble starts a new conversation. Chat is now the first view in the Turnhuddle sidebar, with the Conversations list folded underneath.
highlights.alt: The conversation history open over the Turnhuddle chat, with two bookmarked conversations above two recent ones

highlights.title: The agents' own logos
highlights.text: Turnhuddle shows the logos that the Claude Code and Codex extensions already ship, read from where those extensions are installed on your machine; it doesn't include them itself. The OpenAI blossom switches between black and white to suit light and dark themes. Without those extensions, or with `turnhuddle.vendorLogos` off, you see initials as before.

improvements: The conversation's state is a small coloured dot before its title; hover it for the name.
Bookmarked conversations show 🔖 in the Conversations list and stay at its top.
